text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from training, we stop
by the
shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, a raffle... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's weird, I'm sure I had a ticket in my
pocket...
Is it in my bag, then?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan starts fumbling around,
checking
her pockets.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's in my phone case! I bought a new
one for
New Year's! I just slipped it
between the case and
my phone,
and—whoa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunk!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! My phooooone!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: The screen isn't cracked, is it?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's a little cracked...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Nooo...
choice_data_list: My condolences...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: U-um... Do you wanna try the raffle?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: All right! Good luck!
choice_data_list: I'll do it in your place!
I'll do it instead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give the lever a powerful spin on Tosen
Jordan's
behalf!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap! That's amazing, Trainer! You
got the
grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You can say that again! Maybe we got
lucky
because my phone broke!
choice_data_list: Digging that ticket out was worth it!
Digging that ticket out was worth it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: My phone... broke...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Sure.
choice_data_list: It's the grand prize! You won the grand prize, so please don't cry!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's a coupon for a hot spring getaway,
right?
Hehe, wonder who I should take...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! How am I supposed to choose
just one
person? I want to go with
everyone, but I'm
broke!
choice_data_list: You've got a lot of friends, after all.
You sure have a lot of friends, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just sell the tickets and
take
everyone to karaoke...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was just thinking about how
you're the
one who actually won.
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like there's ages left before it
expires,
anyway. Guess I'll take my
sweet time to think
about who to bring.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Make sure to have fun while you're there.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're really dumb too. You should be
making a
case for yourself right now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You could say it's only fair because you
won it or
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, that looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like them? I love them!
choice_data_list: Do you like it too, Jordan?
Do you like it too, Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? Glad to hear it! Here's your
prize!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. All right, a carrot hamburger
steak.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Looks like your mood improved.
Looks like your mood's back up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I hate it when you give me that face...
Like you're
treating me like I'm a little
kid. Ughhh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She says that, but her tail is up and
wagging
quickly. It looks like she's
delighted to have won
first prize.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Nicely done! Look, your trainer
got the
second prize!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! Awesome, we can eat
ourselves sick!
choice_data_list: It's a whole cardboard box full of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Who should I call?! City, of course. And
Palmer
and Helios—all the regulars! Oh,
I should hook
Tickezo up too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ohh, this is gonna be so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you've got your energy back.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... That's just like you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Here, give me your hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She places a single carrot in my palm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...That's your share. Don't waste it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since she was nice enough to give me a
carrot, I
decide to cook it up and eat it
within the day.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A single carrot...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's whatever. If I had tried, I probably
wouldn't
have gotten anything, so...
choice_data_list: I was hoping to win a good prize, but...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't forget your prize!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's in this bag? ...Wait, carrot
chips?
choice_data_list: She must be really down...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...You did?
choice_data_list: I made this using the carrots from the other day.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, oh my gosh, they're all totally
different
sizes. C'mon, at least make
them match.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah?
choice_data_list: ...Even so, I tried my best.
...Even so, I still gave it my all, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll take 'em.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Forget about it. I wonder if I can get my
phone
fixed.
choice_data_list: Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I think there was some insurance or
something...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thanks...
choice_data_list: ...I'll keep you company.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I leave the shopping district with a
dispirited
Tosen Jordan.
